opportunities.name: Research paper lookup and note
opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced search for a topic restricted to a year, open the top result, find it on Semantic Scholar for author and citation count, and save a summary note.
steps: Open arXiv Advanced search
Type the topic in the search term box
Tick the title/abstract checkbox and select specific year
Enter the year in YYYY
Click Search
Open the top result and read the title
Search that title on Semantic Scholar and open the paper
Read the first author and citation count
Add a note: '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <n> citations'

instances.values: retrieval augmented generation, 2023 -> RIGHT paper, 11 citations
protein structure diffusion, 2024 -> Accelerating Inference in Molecular Diffusion Models, 7 citations

opportunities.name: Case law and statute lookup note
opportunities.description: Find a Supreme Court case on CourtListener for its citation and decision date, look up the related US Code section on Cornell LII, and save a summary note.
steps: Search the case name on CourtListener
Open the matching case result
Read the U.S. citation and decision date
Search the related statute on Cornell LII
Open the statute page and read its title
Add a note: '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<title>)'
